segments.sn13.11:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso sinerussa pabbatarājassa satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhipeyya.
segments.sn13.11:1.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yā vā satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā yo vā sineru [upanikkhittā, sineru vā (sī.)] pabbatarājā”ti?
segments.sn13.11:2.3: Neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti sineruṃ pabbatarājānaṃ upanidhāya satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā”ti.
segments.sn13.11:3.1: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamaṃ upanidhāya aññatitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakānaṃ adhigamo neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti.
segments.sn13.11:3.2: Evaṃ mahādhigamo, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo, evaṃ mahābhiñño”ti.
segments.sn13.11:4.3: Dve pathavī dve samuddā, tayo ca pabbatūpamāti.

lines: Pariyosāne pana aññatitthiyasamaṇabrāhmaṇaparibbājakānaṃ adhigamoti bāhirakānaṃ sabbopi guṇādhigamo paṭhamamaggena adhigataguṇānaṃ satabhāgampi sahassabhāgampi satasahassabhāgampi na upagacchatīti.
Chaṭṭhādīsu vuttanayenevāti idha chaṭṭhasuttādīsu paṭhamasuttādīsu vuttanayenevāti attho veditabbo visesābhāvato.
Tenāha bhagavā paccakkhasabbadhammo “evaṃ mahādhigamo, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo evaṃ mahābhiñño”ti.
